steps.title: GrallocAllocator::allocate (AIDL, mapper4)
steps.description: AIDL IAllocator entry point. Decodes the opaque descriptor blob produced by IMapper::createDescriptor into a buffer_descriptor_t, then calls the shared HIDL-era allocate().

stops.note: Decode the descriptor bytes that IMapper::createDescriptor produced.
Hand the request to the shared allocator code.
Translate the result into an AIDL AllocationError.

steps.title: GrallocAllocator::allocate2 (AIDL V2, mapper5)
steps.description: Allocator V2 entry. Builds buffer_descriptor_t directly from BufferDescriptorInfo via toInternalDescriptor() (producer_usage == consumer_usage == usage).

stops.note: Same shared allocator path as V1.

steps.title: arm::allocator::common::allocate
steps.description: For each requested buffer: allocate pixel memory, then allocate + initialise the shared-metadata dma-buf (name, default dataspace). Records the buffer for dump(). Returns handles via callback, then frees the allocator's own copies.

stops.note: Placeholder buffers get a 1-byte allocation later.
Compute the layout and allocate the pixel memory.
Metadata size = shared metadata + client reserved region.
Write the buffer name into the metadata.
Store a default dataspace for the format and size.
Return the handles to the caller.
Close the allocator's own copies; the client keeps its dup'd fds.

steps.title: mali_gralloc_buffer_allocate
steps.description: Rewrites CPU_*_OFTEN to RARELY for BIG video usage, derives format/size for each descriptor, allocates dma-bufs, and assigns backing_store_id (pid<<32 | counter).

stops.note: Pick the format and compute every plane's size.
Give the buffer a unique id (pid << 32 | counter).

steps.title: mali_gralloc_derive_format_and_size
steps.description: Validates the descriptor, selects the allocation format (base + AFBC modifiers), validates it, then computes layout either via the Exynos path or the generic path.

stops.note: Reject bad usage bits and oversized requests.
Turn modifier bits into an allocation type.
Check the format supports linear or AFBC as chosen.
Exynos formats use their own size rules.
Pad width/height for video and GPU AFBC producers.

steps.title: mali_gralloc_select_format
steps.description: Maps the requested HAL/flex format to a base format (get_base_format), then — unless Exynos/BLOB/usage==0 — derives producers/consumers from usage, intersects their capabilities, and picks the best compatible format with the most AFBC modifiers (get_best_format).

stops.note: Resolve flexible formats such as IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED.
stops.text: const uint32_t req_base_format = get_base_format(req_format, usage, type, true);

stops.note: Exynos formats and BLOB keep the requested format.
Work out who writes the buffer.
Grade compatible formats and pick one.

steps.title: get_best_format
steps.description: Finds compatible formats, grades each supported one by number of AFBC modifier bits; substitutes the best one only when neither producer nor consumer is the CPU.

stops.note: Step 2: check every producer and consumer supports it.
Step 3: grade = 1 + number of AFBC modifier bits.
Step 4: substitute the best format only when no CPU is involved.

steps.title: get_alloc_type
steps.description: Turns AFBC modifier bits into an alloc_type_t: superblock type (16x16 / 32x8 / 64x4), tiled headers, multi-plane, padded, front-buffer-safe.

stops.note: AFBC_PADDING usage pads the header stride.

steps.title: prepare_descriptor_exynos_formats
steps.description: Exynos/SBWC formats: per-format width/height pre-alignment then setup_* helper fills plane sizes/strides/fd indices; GPU usage forces 64-byte stride (and rejects SBWC); each fd gets +1024 bytes, minimum 4 KiB.

stops.note: Per-format pre-alignment, then a setup_* helper.
SBWC with GPU usage is logged as invalid.

steps.title: calc_allocation_size
steps.description: Generic path: per plane, align dimensions (get_pixel_w_h), compute byte stride (with HW/GPU/CPU/camera/BIG alignment via lcm), body size (+AFBC header), and plane offset.

stops.note: Round this plane's width and height.
Bytes per row for an uncompressed plane.
Combine hardware and CPU stride alignment.
The next plane starts where this one ends.

steps.title: mali_gralloc_ion_allocate
steps.description: Creates the private_handle_t and allocates one dma-buf per fd from the heap chosen by select_dmabuf_heap(usage). Optionally (GRALLOC_INIT_AFBC) maps AFBC buffers and writes initial headers.

steps.title: select_dmabuf_heap / alloc_from_dmabuf_heap
steps.description: Picks a heap name from usage (exact-match list then subset list), allocates via libdmabufheap BufferAllocator::Alloc and names the dma-buf.

stops.note: Pick a heap from the usage bits.

steps.title: mali_gralloc_ion_allocate_attr
steps.description: Allocates the extra shared-metadata dma-buf (cached system heap: SW_READ_OFTEN|SW_WRITE_OFTEN) into the fd slot after the buffer fds.

stops.note: Metadata lives in a cached system dma-buf.

steps.title: Mapper::importBuffer
steps.description: Clones the incoming native handle (dup's fds), registers it (validate magic + BufferManager::retain) and adds it to the registered-handle pool.

stops.note: Clone the handle: the fds are dup'd into this process.
Remember the handle so freeBuffer can find it.

steps.title: registerBuffer
steps.description: private_handle_t::validate (magic 0x3141592) then mali_gralloc_reference_retain.

steps.title: BufferManager::retain
steps.description: Creates (or finds) the per-handle MappedData record and increments ref_count. No mmap happens at import time.

steps.title: Mapper::lock → lockBuffer
steps.description: Dups and waits on the acquire fence, validates the handle is imported, then calls mali_gralloc_lock with the access rectangle.

stops.note: Take ownership of the acquire fence.
Wait until the producer has finished writing.
Map and lock for the CPU.

steps.title: mali_gralloc_lock
steps.description: Validates region/usage (rejects AFBC buffers), lazily maps the buffer, returns the base address, sets cpu_read/cpu_write and (if GRALLOC_ION_SYNC_ON_LOCK) starts dma-buf CPU sync; increments locked_ref_count.

stops.text: status = validate_lock_input_parameters(buffer, l, t, w, h, usage);

stops.note: Start CPU access (cache sync if enabled).

steps.title: validate_lock_input_parameters
steps.description: Any modifier bit in alloc_format (i.e. AFBC) makes lock fail with GRALLOC1_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED; non-CPU usage fails with -EINVAL.

stops.note: Any AFBC modifier: lock is refused.
No CPU usage bit: lock is refused.

steps.title: BufferManager::map_buffer_locked → mali_gralloc_ion_map
steps.description: On first map: sanity-checks the dma-buf sizes (lseek) and mmaps every buffer fd; protected / NOZEROED buffers are not mapped unless PRIVATE_NONSECURE.

steps.title: mali_gralloc_ion_map
steps.description: mmap(PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED) of each fd with its alloc_size.

stops.note: Secure buffers are never mapped for the CPU.

steps.title: buffer_sync
steps.description: Records CPU read/write direction; with GRALLOC_ION_SYNC_ON_LOCK it brackets the access with BufferAllocator CpuSyncStart/End (DMA_BUF_IOCTL_SYNC).

stops.note: Record whether the CPU reads and/or writes.
DMA_BUF sync start — only with GRALLOC_ION_SYNC_ON_LOCK.

steps.title: Mapper::unlock → unlockBuffer
steps.description: Validates the handle and calls mali_gralloc_unlock; release fence is always -1 (synchronous).

stops.note: No release fence: unlock is synchronous.

steps.title: mali_gralloc_unlock
steps.description: buffer_sync(TX_NONE) ends CPU sync (if enabled) and clears cpu_read/cpu_write; decrements locked_ref_count. The mapping stays until the last reference is released.

stops.note: End sync, clear the CPU flags.

steps.title: Mapper::freeBuffer
steps.description: Removes the handle from the registered pool, unregisters it, then closes the handle's fds and deletes it.

steps.title: unregisterBuffer
steps.description: Validates and calls mali_gralloc_reference_release.

steps.title: BufferManager::release
steps.description: Decrements ref_count; at zero, munmaps the buffer (mali_gralloc_ion_unmap) and metadata, and erases the record.

steps.title: mali_gralloc_ion_unmap
steps.description: munmap each mapped fd region and clear cpu_read/cpu_write.

steps.title: mali_gralloc_buffer_free (allocator side)
steps.description: Called by the allocator service right after it hands the handles back (Allocator.cpp), closing its own fds; the client's imported clone keeps the dma-buf alive.

stops.note: Allocator side: close its copy of the fds.

steps.title: validate_descriptor
steps.description: Rejects obsolete or invalid usage bits, any additional options, and (except BLOB) requests larger than 400 MB at 4 bytes per pixel.

stops.note: Obsolete usage bits fail the request.
Invalid usage bits fail the request.
Size limit: 400 MB at 4 bytes per pixel (BLOB is exempt).

steps.title: get_base_format
steps.description: Maps flexible formats to a concrete base format from usage: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED, YCbCr_420_888 and P010 become Exynos SPN, SBWC, Google NV12 or NV21 depending on GPU/composer, camera, BIG and codec bits.

stops.note: GPU texture or composer → Exynos NV12 (SPN).
Camera → MFC only: SBWC compressed unless the property disables it.
YCbCr_420_888: BIG → Google NV12, codec → SPN, camera write → NV21.
P010: BIG → Google 10-bit NV12, codec → Exynos P010 SPN.
Map to the internal format id.

steps.title: get_producers
steps.description: Usage → producer IP bits: CPU (SW_WRITE), DPU (composer + encoder, no decoder), GPU (render / GPU data buffer), camera, a video IP (BIG, MFC or VPU) and TPU.

stops.note: Any SW_WRITE bit: the CPU writes.
Composer + encoder without decoder: the DPU writes (screen recording).
HW_RENDER or GPU data buffer: the GPU writes.
Decoder: BIG, MFC or the generic VPU.

steps.title: get_consumers
steps.description: Usage → consumer IP bits: composer alone means DPU only; otherwise CPU (SW_READ), DPU (HW_FB, or texture + composer), video IP, GPU (texture / data buffer) and TPU.

stops.note: Only HW_COMPOSER: the display reads it, nothing else.
Any SW_READ bit: the CPU reads.
Encoder: BIG, MFC or the generic VPU.
HW_TEXTURE or GPU data buffer: the GPU reads.

steps.title: get_producer_caps
steps.description: AND of the capability masks of every producer that has OPTIONS_PRESENT; YUV AFBC read is removed because producers do not read. No producer → 0.

stops.note: Fill the capability masks on first use.
AND in the GPU's mask (only if OPTIONS_PRESENT).

steps.title: get_ip_capabilities
steps.description: Fills the per-IP capability masks once (mutex + flag). Unlike Arm r56p0 there is no XML: the masks are set in code, the GPU's from MALI_GPU_SUPPORT_* build flags, and GRALLOC_ARM_NO_EXTERNAL_AFBC clears AFBC everywhere.

stops.note: DPU: AFBC basic + YUV read (wide block on Zuma).
GPU AFBC features come from build flags.
Build option: AFBC off for every IP.

steps.title: get_consumer_caps
steps.description: AND of the capability masks of every consumer with OPTIONS_PRESENT; YUV AFBC write is removed because consumers do not write.

steps.title: get_active_caps
steps.description: Format/IP-specific limits on the capabilities: YUV needs AFBC YUV write/read, GPU-written YUV AFBC is 16×16 only, GPU→GPU prefers 16×16, DPU split-block only for 24/32-bit RGB.

stops.note: YUV formats need AFBC YUV write (producer) and read (consumer).
GPU → GPU: drop split/wide so 16×16 is used.
stops.text: // TODO: b/183385318 Prefer 16x16 AFBC over 32x8 for GPU --> GPU

steps.title: get_supported_format
steps.description: For one base format: support flags from is_format_supported (retrying without the DPU when GPU+DPU both consume and nothing fits), then the AFBC modifiers from get_afbc_format, dropped again for NO_AFBC usage or an invalid multi-plane layout.

stops.note: No IP support row for this format: unsupported.
Support flags (linear / AFBC) for these IPs.
Nothing fits GPU+DPU: retry with the GPU only (it can compose a DPU fallback).
NO_AFBC usage, or no modifier chosen: linear.
Multi-plane format without multi-plane AFBC: linear.

steps.title: is_format_supported
steps.description: Starts from the formats_ip_support[] table row, then removes AFBC when an IP lacks AFBC basic, multi-plane, YUV read/write or double-body (front buffer); RGBA_1010102 and RGBA_16161616 fall back to linear.

stops.note: Start from the IP support table.
No shared AFBC basic: AFBC off.
Multi-plane AFBC needs tiled headers + extra-wide + multiplane read and no producer.
RGBA_1010102 without the capability: linear only.

steps.title: ip_supports_base_format
steps.description: AND of the table entries cpu_wr/gpu_wr/dpu_wr/cam_wr/vpu_wr for producers and cpu_rd/gpu_rd/dpu_rd/vpu_rd for consumers.

steps.title: get_afbc_format
steps.description: Turns on every AFBC feature both sides share: basic, sparse (if the producer cannot write non-sparse), tiled headers, double body for front buffers, and split + wide block when the GPU consumes. YUV transform is disabled with #if 0. Not for VPU → VPU.

stops.note: YUV transform is compiled out (screen corruption, per the TODO).
Sparse when the producer cannot write non-sparse.
Tiled headers when both sides support them.

steps.title: validate_afbc_format
steps.description: Makes the modifier set legal: double body drops wide blocks, wide + split is not allowed for subsampled YUV, wide RGB > 16 bpp needs split, RGB565 never splits, unsupported features are cleared and sparse is forced when needed.

stops.note: Double body: no wide / extra-wide blocks.
Subsampled YUV: wide wins over split.
Wide RGB > 16 bpp: enable split if both sides support it, else drop wide.
Force sparse if the producer cannot write non-sparse.

steps.title: grade_format
steps.description: Grade = 1 + 1 for every AFBC modifier bit set. (Arm r56p0 adds +2 for AFBC and 2^30 for AFRC instead.)

steps.title: validate_format
steps.description: AFBC needs a format with afbc=true and a plane count that matches single/multi-plane AFBC; uncompressed needs linear=true; BLOB height must be 1.

stops.note: AFBC chosen for a format without AFBC support.
Plane count must match single/multi-plane AFBC.
Linear chosen for a format without linear support.

steps.title: mali_gralloc_adjust_dimensions
steps.description: Video producers add 16 (tiled) or 32 rows to AFBC YUV420 buffers; GPU producers pad AFBC buffers to 16×16.

steps.title: get_pixel_w_h
steps.description: Per plane: align to the format's align_w/align_h, subsample chroma, then align width to align_w_cpu (CPU) or to the AFBC superblock / header tile (8×8 or 4×4 superblocks when tiled).

stops.note: Tiled headers: 4×4 superblocks above 32 bpp, else 8×8.

steps.title: select_dmabuf_heap
steps.description: Exact-match table first (faceauth / ISP / TPU / secure framebuffer heaps), then subset table (secure heaps, sensor, camera GCMA, system). SW_READ_OFTEN turns an uncached heap into its cached twin.

stops.note: First table entry whose bits are all set.

steps.title: GrallocAllocator::isSupported (AIDL V2)
steps.description: AIDL allocator V2: converts the BufferDescriptorInfo and asks the shared isSupported.

stops.note: Note: this log line is printed when the answer is yes (the condition is not negated).
stops.text: MALI_GRALLOC_LOGV("Allocation for the given description will not succeed");

steps.title: arm::allocator::common::isSupported
steps.description: Runs the full format/size derivation on the descriptor; success means an allocation would succeed. Nothing is allocated.

stops.note: Same derivation as a real allocation.

steps.title: common::isSupported (IMapper 4.0)
steps.description: HIDL mapper 4.0 variant (GRALLOC_MAPPER_4): builds a buffer_descriptor_t with producer = consumer usage and runs the same derivation.

steps.title: GrallocMapper::importBuffer (AIMapper v5)
steps.description: Stable-C mapper (AIMapper v5) entry; null-checks and forwards to common::importBuffer.

steps.title: GrallocMapper::lock (AIMapper v5)
steps.description: Stable-C entry. The v5 API passes ownership of the acquire fence, so it is closed here after common::lock.

stops.note: Close the fence: v5 hands ownership to the mapper.

steps.title: common::lock
steps.description: Validates the handle (magic number) and calls lockBuffer.

stops.text: const Error error = lockBuffer(bufferHandle, cpuUsage, accessRegion,

steps.title: common::flushLockedBuffer
steps.description: While locked: end the CPU-write sync so the device sees CPU writes, without unlocking.

steps.title: common::rereadLockedBuffer
steps.description: While locked: start a CPU-read sync so the CPU sees new device writes.

steps.title: GrallocMapper::unlock (AIMapper v5)
steps.description: Stable-C entry; forwards to common::unlock.

steps.title: common::unlock
steps.description: Checks the handle is in the registered-handle pool, then unlockBuffer.

steps.title: GrallocMapper::freeBuffer (AIMapper v5)
steps.description: Stable-C entry; forwards to common::freeBuffer.

steps.title: GrallocMapper::getMetadata (AIMapper v5)
steps.description: Standard metadata types go to getStandardMetadata; Pixel vendor types (VIDEO_HDR, VIDEO_ROI, VIDEO_GMV, PLANE_DMA_BUFS) to getPixelMetadataHelper.

steps.title: common::getStandardMetadata
steps.description: Uses the framework's provideStandardMetadata to encode one value from getStandardMetadataHelper into the caller's buffer.

steps.title: getStandardMetadataHelper
steps.description: One branch per standard type: identity fields from the handle, PLANE_LAYOUTS/STRIDE from get_plane_layouts, name/crop/dataspace/blend/HDR from shared metadata. COMPRESSION reports AFBC when the AFBC basic bit is set.

stops.note: COMPRESSION: AFBC if the basic bit is set.
CROP from shared metadata (default: width × height).
STRIDE: plane 0 width in pixels (bytes for RAW10/12).

steps.title: get_plane_layouts
steps.description: PlaneLayout per plane. Exynos formats use each plane's own size; others use 'up to the next plane' (last plane: rest of the layer). AFBC uses bpp_afbc; RAW10/RAW12 report sample increment 0.

stops.note: Exynos formats: each plane's own size.
Warning: offsets of multi-fd formats are unreliable.
stops.text: MALI_GRALLOC_LOGW("Offsets in plane layouts of multi-fd format (%s %" PRIu64

stops.note: Plane size = up to the next plane.

steps.title: getPixelMetadataHelper
steps.description: Pixel vendor metadata: video HDR / ROI / GMV from the shared metadata region and PLANE_DMA_BUFS (one fd per plane).

stops.note: Video HDR blob from shared metadata.

steps.title: GrallocMapper::setMetadata (AIMapper v5)
steps.description: Standard types go to setStandardMetadata, Pixel types to setPixelMetadata (only VIDEO_GMV can be set). Unknown types return NONE.

steps.title: GrallocMapper::setStandardMetadata
steps.description: Identity fields return BAD_VALUE; blend mode, CTA-861.3, dataspace, SMPTE 2086, SMPTE 2094-40 and crop are decoded and applied; everything else UNSUPPORTED.

steps.title: setStandardMetadataHelper
steps.description: Writes the decoded value into the shared metadata via common::set_* (always returns NONE, even if set_crop_rect rejects the rectangle).

steps.title: set_crop_rect
steps.description: The crop must lie inside plane 0 and its size must equal the buffer's width × height; it is stored in the shared metadata dma-buf.

stops.note: Rectangle must be inside plane 0 and exactly width × height.

steps.title: common::get (IMapper 4.0)
steps.description: HIDL mapper 4.0 path: the handle must be imported, then get_metadata.

steps.title: get_metadata
steps.description: IMapper 4.0 encoder: one switch case per standard type plus the Pixel vendor types; any error becomes UNSUPPORTED.

steps.title: common::set (IMapper 4.0)
steps.description: HIDL mapper 4.0 path: the handle must be imported, then set_metadata.

steps.title: set_metadata
steps.description: Settable: dataspace, blend mode, SMPTE 2086, CTA-861.3, SMPTE 2094-40, crop and Pixel VIDEO_GMV. Identity fields → BAD_VALUE, layout-derived ones → UNSUPPORTED.

steps.title: GrallocAllocator::getIMapperLibrarySuffix
steps.description: Allocator service tells libui which mapper library to load: "pixel" → mapper.pixel.so.

steps.title: AIMapper_loadIMapper
steps.description: The library's one exported entry point: hands back the AIMapper function table backed by arm::mapper::GrallocMapper.

steps.title: GrallocMapper::getStandardMetadata (AIMapper v5)
steps.description: What libui calls for typed metadata reads; forwards to common::getStandardMetadata.
